label: Scandinavian
description: Norse-flavoured names (Old Norse/Swedish/Norwegian feel): gata, vegen, vik.

district_notes.civic: Thing-hall, harbour office and the chief's steading around the square.
district_notes.residential: Houses, boat sheds and workshops near the water and the road.
district_notes.farm: Home fields, sheep pasture and farmsteads beyond the houses.

hall.name: Thing Hall
hall.notes: Where the free householders meet and the law is spoken.

court.name: Law Speaker's House
court.notes: Home of the law speaker; cases are heard in the yard.

tax.name: Harbour Dues House
tax.notes: Weighs and taxes goods landed or carried in.

lockup.name: Fetter House
lockup.notes: A stout cell beside the thing hall.

meeting.name: Guild House
meeting.notes: Meeting place of boat-owners and traders.

smithy.name: Smithy
smithy.notes: Forge near water, away from the thatch.

mill.name: Quern Mill
mill.notes: Water mill on the river bank.
